scenes.name: opening
scenes.prompt: A giant ivory piano keyboard spirals down into an impossible circular well above a vermilion desert. The near keys sweep diagonally across the lower left, huge polished black keys rising like dark monoliths. The spiral has a wide hollow center just right of the image center, filled with deep cobalt water. An enormous pearl moon rests in the water far below, with a tiny red sail beside it. The outer keyboard dissolves into folded cream silk along the upper corners. A precise surreal architectural painting with a sweeping spiral and a clear open center. An exquisitely detailed surrealist oil painting, impossible scale and dream logic, luminous jewel-colored enamel and deep velvet shadows. Monumental readable silhouettes, delicate engraved textures and sharp reflected highlights. Broad cinematic composition with dramatic near and far forms. Rich colors remain separated by dark negative space.
